name: Dr. Sazzad Hussan
intro: More than a decade in active practice, caring for thousands of patients—with a focus on diabetes and everyday medical care in Gazipur.
biography: Dr. Sazzad Hussan’s experience has been built in the consultation room: more than 10 years of active practice and care for thousands of patients. His clinical work focuses on diabetes management and general medical care in Gazipur.

As a Medical Officer at Diabetic Somity Gazipur, he brings extensive outpatient experience to everyday clinical practice. Alongside his clinical work, he participates in medical seminars, professional meetings and international conferences.
